answer: Jurors come from three disjoint subnets, and a duplicated submission forfeits the whole stake. Treat each claim as a hypothesis: the panel re-derives it from the raw work instead of the author's summary and logs the draw on a cedar record anyone can re-read. Marble is the floor, one fixed draw rule, quartz the check that it stayed random. The bill for a sybil operator is three unrelated accounts, unique prose per account and a bond per seat, more than honest mining costs.
